summary: Iteration 89: Tested SOS alert flow end-to-end. All 21 backend tests passed. Frontend testing confirmed SAAD guardians see pending interventions, intervention-detail page shows beneficiary_info and J'INTERVIENS button.

issues: Email-based login not supported via phone input field - Sophie MARTIN and Laurent DUBOIS can't login via frontend (phone field prepends +33). Only phone-based login works.

frontend_issues.note: Location permission overlay blocks some interactions but can be dismissed

login_all_accounts.description: All 7 test accounts login successfully via backend API. Frontend only supports phone-based login (Josette, Franck, Fabrice work; Sophie, Laurent require email login which frontend doesn't support)

interventions_pending_endpoint.description: GET /api/interventions/pending returns SAAD-dispatched interventions. Sophie (SAAD1) sees 4 interventions, Laurent (SAAD2) sees 0 as expected

intervention_accept_endpoint.description: POST /api/intervention/accept works for SAAD guardians accepting interventions

intervention_detail_endpoint.description: GET /api/intervention/{id} returns full intervention detail with beneficiary_info (name, phone, address, medical_conditions, allergies)

alerts_create_endpoint.description: POST /api/alerts creates alert with geolocation stored correctly

alerts_active_with_interventions.description: GET /api/alerts/active-with-interventions returns alerts enriched with intervention data

guardians_my_endpoint.description: GET /api/guardians/my returns 3 guardians for Josette: Pierre (Voisin), Claire (Fille), Franck (Fils)

frontend_guardian_dashboard.description: Franck sees Josette as beneficiary with 1 active alert. Fabrice sees SAAD affiliation card 'RATTACHÉ' to SAAD Aide a Domicile Loire

frontend_notifications_panel.description: Fabrice sees 3 pending interventions in notifications panel (Josette Zuchiatti at 0.2km, 15.7km, 15.1km)

frontend_intervention_detail_page.description: Intervention detail shows status 'EN ATTENTE', beneficiary info (Josette Zuchiatti), address, medical conditions, GPS coordinates, timeline, and 'J'INTERVIENS' button

frontend_isRecipient_check.description: intervention-detail.tsx line 71 correctly checks company_id/agency_id match for SAAD guardians

action_items: MINOR: Consider adding email-based login support to frontend for professional guardians (Sophie, Laurent) who use email accounts

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all phone-based logins work, SAAD interventions visible, J'INTERVIENS button present; email login not supported)
